title: rosa communis var. vinealis
intro: Rosa communis var. vinealis, commonly known as Wild Rose Vine, is a variety of the Rosa communis plant species. It is a type of flowering shrub native to Europe and parts of Asia, known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rosa communis var. vinealis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve heart health, and have antimicrobial properties, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
